title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: The unit’s digit (one’s digit) of the product of any six consecutive positive whole numbers is

solutions.text:
Any six consecutive whole numbers include at least one multiple of \(5\) and at least one even number, so their product is a multiple of \(5 \times 2 = 10.\)

A multiple of \(10\) always ends in \(0\).

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Among any six consecutive numbers there is at least one multiple of \(5\) and at least one even number
A multiple of \(5\) times an even number is a multiple of \(10\)
